# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 48 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 48 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 12, Part 5 — The End of the Mandates

**48:1** When I had finished writing down all the commandments, he said to me: "I have now given you all these commandments. Keep them and live by them. You will be able to live by them if your heart stays pure before God. And you'll be able to keep them if you don't mix any worldly craving into them. This ability doesn't come from me — it comes from the Lord."

**48:2** "But if your heart stays consistently directed toward God, everything is possible for you and you will conquer all these challenges. If you turn away from God and start wavering, though — understand this: not one of these things will be possible for you. A person who has turned away from God will be unable to keep them and will be handed over to death."

**48:3** "I want to say this clearly, Hermas: what I've been saying to you is not my own message — these are the words of God, whom I serve. Keep them and live. And I'm not saying this just for you — this message is for everyone who repents and lives this way."

**48:4** "If you keep these commandments you will live and be at peace with everyone — and everyone who keeps them will be at peace with you. So I'm saying it again as a charge: keep them carefully, obey them, and don't let up. If you do these things you will live. If you don't, you will die."

**48:5** When I left him after hearing all of this, I was deeply shaken and afraid. I thought to myself: if even the person who keeps these commandments is barely saved, what will happen to those who don't keep them at all? I was overwhelmed with anxiety and worry. But he said to me: "Don't let those thoughts trouble you. Be strong, do good — and you will receive tremendous glory."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the solemnity and pastoral concern of the Mandates' conclusion.*
